# Real `pmset -g log` lines copied verbatim from public GitHub issues (read with `gh issue view`, 2026-11-12).
# Nothing here is typed in by hand: each line is the issue text unchanged, except where a block header says otherwise.
# Whitespace is kept as published. Where the issue shows spaces instead of the original tab, the block header says so.
# Lines are grouped in blocks: `# === <id> | <url> | <note>` then the lines. Blank lines separate blocks.
# Several reporters run hackintosh/PC hardware; those blocks are marked. No lines from a Mac in a lid-closed, truly asleep
# state are available from a Mac the maintainer owns (their Macs log 0 Sleep lines).

# === openlogi-clamshell | https://github.com/AprilNEA/OpenLogi/issues/1281 | Sept 2026 report, Apple Silicon-style [CDNVA]/[CDNP] tags; shown with spaces (no tab characters in the issue text); first block of two in the issue

2026-09-08 15:18:34 -0600 Notification   Display is turned on
